12.result:
Procedure i. curl -k -i -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X PUT -d @datafile.json https://x.x.x.x/api/sonicos/user/guest/user/uuid/id ( Note: Edit someparameters from the json file used in testcases 1-2) ii. Ensure the above command returns Success = true iii. Retrieve the pending config: curl -k -i -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json" -X GET https://x.x.x.x/api/sonicos/config/pending iv. Commit pending config: Commit the pending config: curl -k -i -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Accept: application/json" -X POST https://x.x.x.x/api/sonicos/config/pending
  v. Verify commit is successful, verify the commited configuration via GUI vi. Send traffic and verify the functionality for the newly edited service /object/policy vii. Repeat the PUT command of the same action object with new name
